 Final rules 
 Requirements
 Before you post your first clip, review these requirements. Videos that don't meet every requirement won't be approved for payout.
 Content may be sourced from any video/stream/clip featuring TJR
 Submitted videos must feature TJR
 Videos can only be posted on TikTok , Instagram Reels , and YouTube Shorts .
 Audience must be at least 50% native English-speaking countries (USA, CA, AU, UK, NZ).
 Accounts usual audience may not be in a vastly different niche. (e.g posting TJR clips on a bird watching profile may make your video subject to rejection).
 Your captions must use the hashtag: #TJR
 Payouts start once your video hits the Minimum View Requirement (5,000 views) and is approved.
 Videos cannot portray TJR in a negative light.
 Views and engagement cannot be manipulated in anyway. (Botting,Reposts,Collab Posts, ETC.)
 Logos of any kind are not allowed .
 No Repetitive/Non Content Matching Thumbnails & Japanese Captions/Descriptions.
 What to look for: 
 Funny moments from TJR's social media accounts
 Memorable quotes from TJR's social media accounts
 Other reactions or memorable moments from TJR's social media accounts

 Get paid
 All payouts run through Whop's Content Rewards. Here's the flow from posting to cash-out.
 Open The Content Rewards App
 You'll find it inside the Whop Community. This is where you submit your clip links and track approval status.
 Verify Your Whop Account
 Before you can be paid, you need to verify your account by connecting your socials. Go to Whop → Settings → Connected Accounts.
 Submit Your Video Links
 Once verified, head back to Content Rewards and paste the link to every TJR clip you've posted. Submit within 30 minutes of posting.
 Hit MVR And Get Approved
 Once your video crosses the Minimum View Requirement and an approver signs off, your payout queues up automatically.
 Questions? Open a support ticket in the Reach Discord. For Whop-specific issues such as payouts or account verification, contact Whop support.
 Account creation
 If you don't already have a relevant clipping page with 100+ followers, we strongly recommend setting up a dedicated TJR clipping account.
 If you have a pre-existing account in a relevant niche, you can skip account creation.
 Create Fresh Accounts
 Make new accounts on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
 Pick a Campaign-Related Username
 Use a name related to TJR. Examples: TJRClips , TJRDaily , TJRMoments , or TJRReels .
 Set a Profile Picture
 Use the campaign thumbnail or official TJR artwork.
 Targeting USA
 To help meet the audience requirement:
 Use English-language captions and on-screen text.
 Avoid country-specific slang from outside the target regions.
 Tag US locations only when relevant to the content.
 If you have access to audience insights, check whether your historical audience is primarily from the USA, UK, CA, AU, or NZ.
 Final rules
 Meet every quality standard listed in the Requirements article.
 Submit TJR clips within 30 minutes of posting.
 Read every section of this page before posting your first clip.
 One strike and you're out. Botting views, AI-generated content, or any attempt to game the system removes you from every Reach campaign permanently.
